It depends on the site and my use. For things such as Voat or Reddit I prefer an application because it can provide notifications to my device.

For anything multimedia I also prefer an application. Videos and music tend to work better without the browser to act as a middleman, and media controls such as pause and volume are provided to applications but not browsers.

For sites that I only read content from and never interact I generally prefer the web site.

I like apps for a handful of reasons:

  • Notifications for things like Facebook (and hopefully someday Voat)
  • a dedicated touch friendly UI that can take advantage of more complex menus
  • offline caching for news readers and posts
  • my limited bandwidth means loading native code is an advantage where possible

I know there are lots of people who prefer mobile sites (Voat's mobile site is exceptional) but this always strikes me as a "chocolate vs vanilla" question where there is no one better choice for everyone.
